sloka: तस्मिम्स्तु पुरुष्व्याघ्रे निष्क्रामति कृताञ्जलौ ।आर्तशच्दो महान् जज्ञे स्त्रीणाम न्तःपुरे तदा ॥२-२०-१॥
transliteration: tasmimstu puruṣvyāghre niṣkrāmati kṛtāñjalau ।ārtaśacdo mahān jajñe strīṇāma ntaḥpure tadā ॥2-20-1॥

translations.english: When the tiger among men (Rama) was coming out with folded palms, there arose a huge cry of distress among the ladies of the harem:
